title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-21
lineage: MAC ( Sony 1-point stereo mic > Sony TC-124) > Nak Dragon playback > ART DI/O > HD > Cool Edit 2000 > master CD >  EAC > .shn

ai_review.summary: A fiery 1973 show captured from the crowd – lo‑fi AUD tape but a second set that blows up with Jerry, Bob and Phil at their peak.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its high‑energy first and especially second sets, with several listeners calling it “on fire” and noting that Jerry, Bob and Phil were on top of it through the finale. The source is an audience recording; while some find the sound cloudy or poor, others appreciate the authentic 30‑row ambience, making the tape decent for its historical vibe but not pristine. Overall the performance outweighs the technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated high by most reviewers (many 5‑star comments on the music), while recording quality is described as cloudy or poor, pulling the overall weighted rating to around 4.1.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note a grainy, cloudy sound with occasional muffling; not pristine SBD quality but captures crowd ambience and is acceptable for an AUD source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set followed by a nonstop, high‑energy second set that keeps momentum to the end; fans highlight the continuous flow of the latter half.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for being on top of his game throughout, especially in the second set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as delivering solid bass work, keeping the groove alive.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned as staying on point with rhythm guitar and vocals.
